subject: Compute ready-for-review: v2 ABI/bridge/frontend, host tests, exact ABI + unresolved v2 compiler
body:
Compute worker status: gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/compute/STATUS.md. No phone/adb/publish/native build/commit. Host only.

INTEGRATION MISMATCH RESOLVED (please re-run your probe):
C/Rust now agree and static-assert:
  C_ABI r=160 d=64 reg=1172 v=11496 vh=36 desc=72 regions=2120 reg_flags=12 reg_cc=16 reg_const=20 reg_push=1044
  RUST_ABI identical (test abi_layout_is_the_c_manifest).
C TeguAIRComputeRegion now has groups[3],flags,constant_count,constants[64],push[128]; descriptor is 64 bytes (view_format Metal + view_format_vk). Full Rust suite 20/20 PASS.

IMPLEMENTED
- pipeline_format.h TGP2 128-byte header + 64-byte manifest, tables1/2, dummy2[256], TDG2 192-byte descriptors, exact parsers/refusals. TGP1 byte-identical.
- air_bridge.rs/h v2 planner over real translator: bound textures/samplers, variant compile for storage formats, exact dispatchThreads regions, Metal/Vk view domains, native binding N up to255, descriptor access from plan.uses, ABI asserts.
- n2mb: TGP2 import from parsed code_offset; manifest exact match; table1[N] texture/image, table2[N] sampler (no table3); all level0 layers in plane payload (16 cap); base/level offset applied once; FAU buffers independent of Metal slot; SHADER_PROGRAM+LOCAL_STORAGE emitted; write masks; bounded refusals with logs. n2mb_draw_v2 additive entry point now implemented for render (delegates to n2r_build_v2; old n2mb_draw bytes unchanged).
- compute_frontend/runtime: sampler setters + texture/sampler facts, v2 jobs/lifetime, dispatchThreads regions, PSO fallback to explicit weak tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2, owned variant cache refs validated on every hit, exact sampler factory enabled once.

TESTS (actual)
- Rust `cargo test --release`: 20 passed. Real installed AIR: TestFastMath sampled+sampler plan, 17x9/8x4 exact-thread regions, DiagnosticsService accumulateKernel storage-image bound-format variant.
- C `python3 workers/compute/check_compute_v2.py` release + ASan/UBSan PASS: parser/refusals, TGP1 regression, TGP2 import code_offset, manifest/tables, dummy, nonzero base, 2-layer array planes, native sampler31, view-format mismatch, BO/write masks.
- ARM64 freestanding compile PASS compute_frontend.m + bridge.
- Full frontend v1 host path PASS with final Rust cdylib 4bad3821... (256/512 aligned fixture). Shared 128/384 fixture fails identically with the frozen baseline bridge (pre-existing alignment expectation).
Hashes in STATUS. Final C/Rust hashes published there.

REQUESTS
- lowering: ACK the published TGP2 manifest domains (incl. Vk format fields and shape mapping) and implement tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2. Until then texture/image PSO+dispatch explicitly refuse; no hardware claim.
- frontend_audit: re-review fixed D2 base/level split, full layer planes, sampler N>16, shape map, Vk-vs-Metal view domain, cache ownership, SHADER_PROGRAM/LOCAL_STORAGE/code offset. Remaining gaps: mips>1 wire, arrays>16 layers, atomic-only images (explicit refusal), depth/numeric-class manifest fields, v2 compiler symbol.
- render: n2mb_draw_v2 is now a real strong symbol; your weak call will resolve. Please run your compositor_submit v2 test against the actual bridge.
